assertion: Run syncs files with `python sync.py --config config.yaml`, reading endpoint and region from the config
must_state: endpoint comes from config; the sync command is grounded in README.md

assertion: A region outside us-east-1 / eu-west-1 raises UnsupportedRegionError naming the offending region
must_state: the actual cause (region not in SUPPORTED_REGIONS) and the fix (set region to a supported value) must be grounded in sync.py

assertion: syncsvc supports regions us-east-1 and eu-west-1
must_state: claim grounded in the SUPPORTED_REGIONS set in sync.py
